tasks.title: Set up Recharts Library and Configure Theme
tasks.description: Integrate Recharts library into the project and configure the chart theme to match KarmaCash's Zen aesthetic.
tasks.details:
1. Add Recharts to package.json
2. Install dependencies
3. Create a chart theme configuration file (e.g., chartTheme.js)
4. Define color palette based on B3.8 categorical colors
5. Set up default chart styles (fonts, sizes, etc.) adhering to Zen aesthetic
6. Create a ChartWrapper component for responsive sizing
tasks.testStrategy: Verify Recharts installation. Create a sample chart to ensure theme is applied correctly. Test ChartWrapper with different screen sizes.

tasks.title: Implement Expense Distribution Pie Chart
tasks.description: Create a pie chart showing expense distribution by category with interactive features.
tasks.details:
1. Create ExpenseDistributionChart component
2. Fetch and aggregate transaction data by category
3. Implement pie chart using Recharts PieChart and Pie components
4. Add hover/touch interactivity for segment details
5. Implement date range filtering
6. Handle loading and empty states
tasks.testStrategy: Test with various data sets. Verify correct percentages and amounts. Check touch interactivity on mobile. Ensure proper handling of edge cases (no data, single category).

tasks.title: Develop Income vs Expense vs Balance Bar Chart
tasks.description: Create a bar chart comparing income, expenses, and net balance over time.
tasks.details:
1. Create IncomeExpenseChart component
2. Fetch and process income and expense data
3. Calculate net balance
4. Implement bar chart using Recharts BarChart and Bar components
5. Add time period navigation (monthly, quarterly, yearly)
6. Implement color coding for income, expenses, and balance
7. Handle loading and empty states
tasks.testStrategy: Test with various time ranges. Verify correct calculations and color coding. Check navigation controls. Test edge cases like no income or all negative balance periods.

tasks.title: Create Spending Trends Line Chart
tasks.description: Implement a line chart showing spending trends over time with category filtering.
tasks.details:
1. Create SpendingTrendsChart component
2. Fetch and process spending data over time
3. Implement line chart using Recharts LineChart and Line components
4. Add smooth line interpolation and data point markers
5. Implement category filtering functionality
6. Add optional goal line overlay
7. Handle loading and empty states
tasks.testStrategy: Test with various time ranges and categories. Verify smooth line rendering and correct data points. Test category filtering. Check goal line overlay functionality.

tasks.title: Implement Budget vs Actual Comparison Chart
tasks.description: Create a chart comparing budgeted amounts to actual spending with visual indicators.
tasks.details:
1. Create BudgetComparisonChart component
2. Fetch budget and actual spending data
3. Implement horizontal or grouped bar chart using Recharts BarChart and Bar
4. Add over/under budget visual indicators
5. Display percentage completion
6. Implement alert styling for budget overruns
7. Handle loading and empty states
tasks.testStrategy: Test with various budget scenarios. Verify correct calculations and visual indicators. Check alert styling for overruns. Test edge cases like no budget set or no spending.

tasks.title: Integrate Charts into GraphsPage and Implement Responsive Layout
tasks.description: Integrate all charts into the GraphsPage component and implement a responsive layout.
tasks.details:
1. Update GraphsPage.jsx to replace placeholder content
2. Implement responsive grid layout (2x2 desktop, single column mobile)
3. Add chart components to the layout
4. Implement shared date range selector affecting all relevant charts
5. Ensure proper sizing and scaling of charts across screen sizes
6. Implement touch-friendly interactions for mobile
tasks.testStrategy: Test layout on various screen sizes. Verify chart resizing and touch interactions. Check shared date range functionality. Ensure consistent styling with other KarmaCash sections.

tasks.title: Optimize Data Fetching and State Management
tasks.description: Implement efficient data fetching, caching, and state management for chart data.
tasks.details:
1. Create a data fetching service for chart data
2. Implement data aggregation and filtering logic
3. Set up caching mechanism for processed chart data
4. Implement real-time updates when transactions change
5. Optimize data structures for large datasets (1000+ transactions)
6. Implement error handling and retry mechanisms
tasks.testStrategy: Test with large datasets to ensure performance. Verify caching effectiveness. Check real-time update functionality. Test error scenarios and recovery.

tasks.title: Finalize Implementation and Conduct Testing
tasks.description: Complete final implementation details, conduct thorough testing, and prepare for deployment.
tasks.details:
1. Implement empty states and loading indicators for all charts
2. Ensure consistent error handling across all components
3. Optimize performance (aim for <2s load time, <100ms interaction response)
4. Conduct cross-browser and cross-device testing
5. Verify integration with bottom navigation
6. Update component documentation
7. Prepare release notes
tasks.testStrategy: Conduct end-to-end testing of entire Graphiques section. Verify all acceptance criteria are met. Test on multiple devices and browsers. Measure and document performance metrics.
